verdict.rationale: The skill documents its own install paths: Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install` commands, plus a file-copy route into `.claude/skills/`. An agent could plausibly run the file copy without prompts. However, nothing documents a headless, non-interactive, agent-driven install, and the slash commands appear to run inside an interactive session. Missing for 10: an explicit non-interactive or headless install command, documentation that an agent can run the install end to end without prompts, and hands-on or independent confirmation that an agent install works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
